annotations.title: Who is behind a company or site

description: Resolve a company, subsidiary or site name to its corporate chain: the matched entity, each parent up to the top parent (with the source and date of each link), the sites it operates, and how many Seraphix records are about it. Ownership links come from the Seraphix entity registry (GLEIF accounting consolidation, SAM parent UEI): an accounting relationship, not a finding of beneficial ownership. Covers the tracked companies and their corporate families; an unknown name returns NOT_FOUND, not a guess.
